hook: Their boat flipped. A beacon called for help.
narration: A twelve-foot fishing boat capsized off Oahu, and two men went into the water.
Coast Guard watchstanders in Honolulu got an alert from a personal locator beacon.
A beacon like that sends a distress signal and its position by satellite, so rescuers know where to fly.
A Dolphin helicopter crew from Air Station Barbers Point hovered overhead and sent the basket down, one man at a time.
outcome: The Barbers Point crew rescued both men from the water.
title: Their boat flipped off Oahu and a beacon saved them
description:
A 12-foot fishing vessel capsized offshore Oahu on July 3, 2026, putting two men in the water. After a personal locator beacon alert, an MH-65 Dolphin crew from Coast Guard Air Station Barbers Point rescued both men.
